svg.title: ICUC 2026 Fall AIGC Training Camp Course Schedule
svg.desc: October 11, 2026 to January 10, 2027: 15 class days and 29 sessions. Morning and afternoon classes are shown for each date.
svg.text: Oct 11 is Sunday; the final day is morning only. On-site classes are for Communication University of China students; check school notices for updates.
